messages:
maria: Quick question — for the console SLO surface, should we show the per-tenant effective threshold alongside the routing policy that will trigger fallbacks? We need this before canary.
ashok: I'd prefer showing the active routing policy. Otherwise support won't know why fallbacks fired.
ben: Agree. Also: can we overlay quota burn rate on the SLO chart? During the last noisy tenant incident folks couldn't correlate alerts to quota spikes.
zoe: UX ask: keep the primary SLO line clean, add a compact pill that expands to show routing policy + sampling heuristics. New users shouldn't be overwhelmed.
maria: Rough API proposal: GET /api/v1/slo/{id}?include_routing=true -> returns routing_policy and sampling snapshot. Example payload idea: 
```
{
  "slo_id": "slo_123",
  "threshold": 0.99,
  "routing_policies": [
    {"name":"primary","action":"notify"},
    {"name":"overflow","action":"fallback_to-cheap-model"}
  ],
  "sampling": {"policy":"quiet_window","rate":0.1}
}
```
Thoughts on shape?
ben: Please prefer `routing_policies` as an array (so UI can render priority order). Also expose `effective_threshold` per-tenant to account for inheritance.
ashok: Telemetry: we need counters for `suppressed_alerts`, `sampled_alerts`, and a histogram for `routing_fallback_latency`. These drive whether the UX shows "noisy" badges.
zoe: Figma mock uploaded: https://figma.com/s/console-slo-routing — shows collapsed pill + expanded modal. We should test with 3 different tenant sizes.
maria: Rollout plan suggestion: feature-flagged UI, default off, 5% tenant canary. Feature flag toggle in admin console for immediate rollback. Telemetry must be in before enabling.
svc-deploy-bot: deploy started for feature/console-slo-routing (commit abc123) :rocket:
ben: Note for on-call: add an emergency toggle and a runbook entry to suppress routing-based notifications. We don't want noisy routing changes to trigger churn.
ashok: Implementation note: sampling decisions are compute-heavy; let's precompute per-minute sampling decisions in a worker and store a 60s TTL snapshot in Redis for UI reads. Avoid per-request evaluation in the API.
zoe: UX follow-up: add a tooltip that explains "why this tenant has a different effective threshold" and link to policy docs.
maria: I'll open an RFC with the API schema + telemetry KPIs. Action items: ben — API contract PR, ashok — telemetry counters + metrics dashboard, zoe — update Figma & copy. I'll queue canary ticket and add owners.
ben: On it.
zoe: Will update mocks and add microcopy.
maria: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
